title: Jaisalmer Tour Package From Ahmedabad
content: Looking for a memorable tour package from Ahmedabad to Jaisalmer. Jaisalmer is one of the perfect choices to spend your holidays with your loved ones. The place is for those people and travellers who are mesmerised by royalty, rich culture, and deserts. Due to the presence of deserts, it is also nicknamed the Golden City of India. The city has big, magnificent forts, beautifully carved havelis, ancient temples, and the magnificent Thar Desert. The city is also known for its rich culture and traditional food and clothing.
author: Exportia
